ruler_end: Empress [[minerva]]: interim ruler until November 1776; under the lords’ agreement she then keeps the crown and the [[vechnyj-efes|Eternal Hilt]], while [[ervin-oridzhin|Erwin Origin]] takes command of the army as “shogun.” Governor [[magda-labelin|Magda Labelin]] administers the Crownlands. [[adrian|Adrian]], mayor of Faunterra from early 1776, is killed by [[sofi|Sophie]] in November 1776; his body is not found.
colors: Azure, scarlet, and brown; “gold on azure” are the colors of Yanmei and the Dynasty
predmety: More than 300 (324 in the Imperial Citadel)
notes: The imperial house. Its rulers have not always been of Yanmei blood, but the heirs restore the Yanmei line through marriage.

ruler_end: Duke [[ervin-oridzhin]] from late August 1774; under the lords’ agreement of November 1776 he becomes “shogun,” commander of the imperial army.
sigil: A black bat holding an arrow in its claws (founder Radan Adler chose a small bird catching an arrow)
notes: The most warlike House; its army is the [[kajry]].

ruler_end: In practice [[henri-farvej|Henry Farway]], who declares himself ruler of Almera and is recognized by Ganta Kort. By 1776 the young [[albert-almera|Albert]] is married to Evelyn Farway.
sigil: A fortress tower against a setting sun
notes: The wealthiest duchy. The House is almost wiped out when Evergard falls in 1774.

sigil: Blue dolphins and golden sheaves of wheat; the battle flag shows a black, fanged dolphin on blue
colors: Blue and gold, from the arms
notes: A trading duchy. Its standing rises in 1775 when Magda marries [[adrian|Adrian]].

ruler_end: Count [[elias-nortvud]] becomes effectively the Puppeteer’s puppet in autumn 1775. In 1776, the county is torn by unrest and famine, and the “Bear Brothers,” Adrian’s supporters, represent it in the Chamber.
pramater: Susan. Countess Sibyl and her daughter Gloria are named as members of Susan’s lineage; the text gives no lineage for Count Elias.
sigil: A bear with a raised paw
notes: The “Bears” of the northern forests. In 1775, the heir Craig besieges his own capital, then ruled by his father Elias.

ruler_end: The dowager countess [[iona-oridzhin|Iona]] (1776). [[vittor-shejland]] has been frozen since 3 December 1775 in the [[chrevo]], kept in the Imperial Citadel under [[moris-labelin|Maurice Labelin’s]] supervision.
notes: A young House, granted its county about three centuries ago. In the mid-eighteenth century the Harper bankers effectively take control.

ruler_end: Duke [[henri-farvej]], who also declares himself ruler of Almera
sigil: A bone and a shining cup, according to the Guide. In the novel, Hope’s arms show an armored man with a cross on his chest, and Farway’s banners show “bones and hearts.”
notes: The House has ruled Hope since 1755, following the [[shutovskoj-zagovor]] and the fall of the Lighthearts.

ruler_end: Unnamed (Duke Willas is last mentioned in 1774)
notes: A southern duchy of jungles, ruled by descendants of Yanmei.

ruler_end: King [[frantsisk-ilian]], also patriarch from November 1776 (Prince [[gektor]] rules in practice). He says Shimmery will leave the Empire after Minerva’s coronation.
pramater: The House’s lineage is not stated; Prince Hector is of the line of Sophia the Majestic.
sigil: A roaring lion with a paw on a ball
notes: A conditionally independent kingdom of House Nellis-Lyon. Laws are passed by the Council of Five.

ruler_end: Queen [[mirej-nen-kler|Mireille Nen-Clair]] takes the throne in 1776 with Shimmery’s Scorching Sun Regiment. The [[ledi-vo-tme|Lady in the Dark]] is killed in December 1775. Mireille’s rival Emmon Darklin represents Darkwater in the Chamber.
pramater: [[pramater-yanmej|Yanmei]] (the queen is of pure Yanmei blood)
notes: A Great House with a royal title under a fourteenth-century treaty, but comparable in strength to the counties.

ruler_start: Count Damir Reis, killed in August 1774
ruler_end: [[ganta-kort]], “ruler of the Steppe,” has not been confirmed as count. [[yukhan-rejs|Juhan Reis]] dies in December 1775. Peace with Origin from 1776.
notes: A steppe county of the [[shavany]]. The counts have only nominal authority over the gantas.
A western county on the sacred river. Trade and a river fleet make its counts more powerful than those of Reis.

ruler_start: Nominally Baron Fairis; in practice, a council of barons and mayors
ruler_end: Nominally Baron Fairis; in practice, a council of barons and mayors
notes: Heir to the Empire of the Iron Sun. Fairis is the only baron among the great lords.

ruler_start: Count Rantigar, killed on 15 September 1774 in Faunterra
ruler_end: Three rulers: Eldest Son Corvin, who retakes Silence; his brother Dainis Rantigar; and General Horis (Oris)
notes: The Empire’s most secretive land, home to the [[zakatniki]] and the cult of the Fallen.
